name: capsa-agent-cookbook
description: Recipes and installable skills for using the Capsa MCP connector alongside email, docs, and calendar to complete real work.

discovery.note: Capability availability and filter values are resolved live. Use a broad discovery tool only when needed; load one selected recipe or reference page, never the full cookbook for each call.

start_here.description: What an agent can do, the orient -> resolve -> act -> record -> log loop, the safety contract, and example prompts to try.

skills.name: capsa-orientation
skills.description: First-time orientation and approval rules; load once when needed, not before every call.

skills.name: proposal-followup-batch
skills.description: Clear a batch of outstanding proposal follow-ups: draft per contact, review, send via a connected email provider, mark done only on send evidence.

skills.name: sensitive-visit-notice
skills.description: Draft customer pre-notices for upcoming visits flagged sensitive (e.g. chemical application); the user approves each before sending.

skills.name: renewal-portfolio-triage
skills.description: Pull the renewal book for a scope, tier it with explainable rules (dollars at risk, time pressure, margin flags, payment and satisfaction risk), and present a ranked worklist the user prunes before any deep dive.

skills.name: renewal-deep-dive
skills.description: Build a renewal recommendation for one property from Capsa's renewal drilldowns and property context: price/hours/terms options with cited evidence. The agent proposes; the user decides.

skills.name: meeting-notes-to-command-center
skills.description: Turn AI meeting notes (Granola, Fathom, Otter, or pasted text) into a reviewed Command Center property note: resolve the property via the primary contact, require the user to confirm the exact property and note text, then write it — never to the wrong property.

skills.name: property-site-update
skills.description: Pull a property's relationship, health, satisfaction, and outstanding-item context, then draft an internal brief and a customer-safe update for the property manager covering what happened, what's upcoming, and what's needed from them. The agent never sends.

skills.name: property-plan-builder
skills.description: Build or evolve a property's forward-looking plan with the user from Capsa's health, satisfaction, planning, and pipeline context plus any existing future-plans notes, then save the approved text as a Command Center property note flagged for future plans. Internal by default; the agent never sends it to the customer.

skills.name: job-book-review
skills.description: Scan and rank a branch/division's active (WIP) job book by health or margin erosion, shortlist the jobs worth a closer look, then pull a compact card and targeted drilldowns per job and draft a review memo.

skills.name: property-book-triage
skills.description: Start with the fixed "what needs my attention today" queue, broaden with a configurable metric sweep over the property book, then hand the shortlist to a follow-up, note, or renewal recipe.

skills.name: budget-item-change
skills.description: Propose a create or edit to a property's budget item, review near-duplicate warnings, and save only after the user approves that exact proposal. A saved budget item is live in Command Center planning immediately, not a draft.

skills.name: price-recommendation-change
skills.description: Propose a create or edit to a property's price increase recommendation, review near-duplicate warnings, and save only after explicit approval. Every save stays a draft for a person to review in Command Center.

skills.name: scorecard-review
skills.description: Confirm the metric, dimension, and date basis with the analytics catalog, run an Ops or Sales Scorecard query, drill into a specific cell, and bring in property-level penetration/profitability context.

skills.name: improvement-plan-start
skills.description: Start a Command Center improvement plan for one property: agree the goal and target, prepare the exact proposal, save only on explicit approval, report the baseline Capsa measured.

capabilities.name: followup_actions
capabilities.description: Outstanding proposal follow-ups with customer context and contact candidates; evidence-gated completion.

capabilities.name: upcoming_visits
capabilities.description: Scheduled visits with property, service, account-owner, and customer-contact context for notice workflows.

capabilities.name: property_context
capabilities.description: Search properties and pull production, satisfaction, sales, and upcoming-visit signals; filter, rank, or triage a property book by dimension, metric, or date range.

capabilities.name: job_context
capabilities.description: The job-grain equivalent of property context: rank a branch/division's active (WIP) job book, then pull a compact card and ticket/crew/billing/issue/health-history drilldowns for one job.

capabilities.name: renewal_opportunities
capabilities.description: The renewal book for a window — prior contract baseline, pipeline by status, retention, price/scope change tags — plus per-property service comparisons and prior-year performance review.

capabilities.name: command_center_notes
capabilities.description: Resolve a property from a meeting's primary-contact context, have the user confirm the exact property, then save a Command Center property note with an optional Aspire property-note append.

capabilities.name: budget_planning
capabilities.description: Propose a create or edit to a property's Command Center budget item, review near-duplicate warnings, and save only after explicit approval. A saved item is live in Command Center planning immediately.

capabilities.name: price_recommendations
capabilities.description: Propose a create or edit to a property's draft Command Center price increase recommendation, review near-duplicate warnings, and save — always as a draft for a person to review — only after explicit approval.

capabilities.name: product_feedback
capabilities.description: Log an unmet user request (metric, data shape, workflow, or action) for Capsa product review when the connector can't satisfy it. Loop step 5.

capabilities.name: scorecard_queries
capabilities.description: Run supported Ops or Sales Scorecard analytics with explicit dates, metrics, dimensions, and filters, and drill into the rows behind one selected cell.

capabilities.name: property_analytics
capabilities.description: Run Property Penetrations or Property Profitability by-property report analytics with explicit dates, filters, defaults, and guidance.

capabilities.name: improvement_plans
capabilities.description: Read the Command Center improvement plans the connected user can see, and start a new one through a prepare-then-save flow; live on save, one open plan per property and goal.

patterns.name: resolving-ambiguous-names
patterns.description: Work out which dimension a user's term belongs to (sales rep? account owner? property?) before filtering or reporting.

entrypoint.description: Small routing index. Read this first, then load only one relevant recipe or reference page.
